title: P2a per workspace overlay cache design
summary: Replaced the single-slot state.overlay write-coalescing cache with a per-workspace Map keyed by absolute workspace path, via overlayFor(ws) in daemon.js. Design: overlayFor(state.workspace) returns state.overlay directly (no second Map copy) so the current workspace stays the authoritative in-memory entry and test hooks (__setOverlayForTest/__setWorkspaceForTest) keep working with zero extra wiring; every OTHER workspace is cached in the Map, loaded on miss. Cache coherency uses mtime invalidation on the overlay file (reusing the existing overlayStamp helper) — matches the pre-P2a per-call load() behavior so out-of-band writes (other processes/tests) are picked up on next lookup; no NEW staleness class. refreshOverlayStamp(ws) re-stamps after the daemon's own save so coalescing survives the self-induced rename mtime bump (targetOverlay.save() calls it). All 8 coherence ternaries (ws===state.workspace)?state.overlay:overlayStore.load(ws) rerouted to overlayFor: aggregateCached, targetOverlay, sweepStaleLoops, decideAll sweeps loop, ctxFor, makeResolver.loadWs, buildGraph, periodic claim-sweep interval. state.workspace/state.overlay kept for P3.
